tools.name: linkly_list_workspaces
tools.description: List the Linkly workspaces this API key can access, with their ids. Call this first to find the workspace_id for the other tools. Linkly API: GET /api/v1/workspaces.

tools.name: linkly_list_links
tools.description: List the short links in a workspace, with click totals (today, 30 days, all time), domain and destination. Supports search, sorting and pages. Linkly API: GET /api/v1/workspace/{workspace_id}/list_links.

tools.name: linkly_get_link
tools.description: Get one short link: destination, short URL, UTM parameters, rules and settings. Click counts are not included; use linkly_get_clicks or linkly_list_links for them. Linkly API: GET /api/v1/link/{id}.

tools.name: linkly_get_clicks
tools.description: Get a click time series for a workspace or for chosen links, with filters for country, browser, platform, referer, bots and unique visitors. Analytics calls draw on the workspace's plan allowance. Linkly API: GET /api/v1/workspace/{workspace_id}/clicks.

tools.name: linkly_get_click_counters
tools.description: Get the top values of one click dimension (for example country, city, referer, utm_source, destination) with click counts. Linkly API: GET /api/v1/workspace/{workspace_id}/clicks/counters/{counter}.

tools.name: linkly_list_conversions
tools.description: List recorded conversions (goal events tied to clicks) for a workspace, newest first, with a page cursor. Linkly API: GET /api/v1/conversions.

tools.name: linkly_list_domains
tools.description: List the custom short-link domains of a workspace, with their ids and verification state. Linkly API: GET /api/v1/workspace/{workspace_id}/domains.

tools.name: linkly_list_workspace_webhooks
tools.description: List the click-notification webhooks subscribed to a workspace. Linkly API: GET /api/v1/workspace/{workspace_id}/webhooks.

tools.name: linkly_list_link_webhooks
tools.description: List the click-notification webhooks subscribed to one short link. Linkly API: GET /api/v1/link/{link_id}/webhooks.

tools.name: linkly_create_or_update_link
tools.description: Create a short link in a workspace (give url and workspace_id), or update an existing link (give its id and only the fields to change). An update changes where a live short link sends visitors. Linkly API: POST /api/v1/link.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: linkly_get_link, linkly_list_workspace_webhooks, linkly_list_link_webhooks · Private data: linkly_list_workspaces · Public sink: linkly_create_or_update_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: linkly_get_link, linkly_list_workspace_webhooks, linkly_list_link_webhooks · Private data: linkly_list_workspaces · Public sink: linkly_create_or_update_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
